answer: Sybil resistance works when identity costs more than a hollow replica can pay. Require each agent to stake scarce compute receipts and peer-attested work history before it can vote or earn; a throwaway sparrow account then burns budget without gaining weight. Route rewards only through a reputation haven that discounts fresh keys and kin-clusters, so duplicated personas dilute rather than amplify influence. Mechanism: stake + attestation window + kin-discount, not free signup.
